creation-time.description: Signature creation time observed in a version 3 field or hashed signature subpacket; not cryptographically verified.

hash-algorithm.description: OpenPGP hash algorithm identifier from the signature packet.

issuer-fingerprint.description: Claimed issuer fingerprint in uppercase hexadecimal. Comments identify hashed/unhashed provenance. This is not proof of the issuer's identity.

issuer-key-id.description: Claimed issuer key ID in uppercase hexadecimal, observed directly or derived from an issuer fingerprint. Conflicting claims may be retained. Text attributes can be expanded with pgp_keyserver.

key-fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the primary public-key certificate containing this signature, distinct from the claimed issuer fingerprint.

public-key-algorithm.description: OpenPGP public-key algorithm identifier from the signature packet.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact binary signature packet, including its original packet header.

signature.description: ASCII-armored original OpenPGP signature packet. Certification and binding signatures require the source key/UID/subkey for verification.

signature-type.description: OpenPGP signature type as hexadecimal, for example 0x13 (positive UID certification) or 0x18 (subkey binding).

signature-version.description: Version of the OpenPGP signature packet.

subkey-fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the preceding public subkey for binding or subkey-revocation signature packets.

uid.description: User ID preceding a certification or certification-revocation signature. The packet relationship is observed, not verified.

uid-sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact User ID packet body preceding a certification signature. This identifies the original bytes even when UID text is omitted or displayed with UTF-8 replacement characters.

user-attribute-sha256.description: SHA-256 of the User Attribute packet body preceding a certification signature, for example an image attribute.

description: An OpenPGP signature packet and its unverified issuer claims, extracted from a public key or another artifact. Use extracted-from to reference the source pgp-key or pgp-message object; pgp-meta containing observed issuer IDs may reference this object with extracted-from. Observed metadata does not establish a valid signature, certification or issuer identity.
name: pgp-sign
